name: Ironpage
body:
School abjuration [earth]; Level bard 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target book or scroll touched
Duration 1 day/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

Ironpage protects one book or scroll from damage. Not every book is eligible to be the target of this spell—only finely crafted works worth no less than one gp/page of text or 20 gp total can be affected by ironpage. The book or scroll is no longer considered flammable (it can be damaged by fire, but never catches on fire), is completely waterproof, and gains a hardness of 15 and 1 hp per gp of value.
